integrity: Original contribution is the quantitative arithmetic density/period phase diagram; one-variable Epperson boundedness and tensorization are acknowledged as existing. Search-based priority is qualified, and independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to diagonal positive two-rate Gaussian Ornstein–Uhlenbeck generators on product Lp, p not two; only infinite-imaginary-time density and exact period transitions. No finite-window discrepancy or nondiagnonal-drift stability claimed.
title: Arithmetic phase transitions in complex-time boundedness of a two-rate Gaussian semigroup
